'''Giana Kayl''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Meridian Grace]]'' during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] she was delivering cargo from [[Tai Cordan]] for the [[Balmorran resistance]], a list of major supply caches hidden before the Imperial invasion of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. Unfortunately, the ''Meridian Grace'' was shot down and Kayl only had time to send a single holomessage before it crashed.
